map.由溶质与溶液质量求质量分数（浓度）: Find the mass fraction, the percentage concentration, from the solute and solution masses
map.输入溶质质量与溶液总质量，求质量分数（百分比浓度）。: Enter the solute mass and the total solution mass to get the mass fraction, the percentage concentration.
map.📖 查看「由溶质与溶液质量求质量分数（浓度） 使用指南」: 📖 View Guide: "Find the mass fraction from the solute and solution masses"
map.w = m_溶质 / m_溶液。 9 g NaCl 溶于 100 g 溶液 →: w = m_solute / m_solution. 9 g of NaCl in 100 g of solution gives 9%.
map.9 g NaCl 溶于 100 g 溶液 → 9%。: 9 g of NaCl in 100 g of solution gives 9%.
map.📚 深度解析：由溶质与溶液质量求质量分数（浓度）: 📚 Deep Dive: Finding the mass fraction from the solute and solution masses
map.配方标注：由原料配比算活性物质量百分数，写标签。: Labelling a formulation: compute the mass percentage of the active substance from the raw material ratio to write the label.
map.质检核对：实测含量对照标称百分数，判合格。: Quality checks: compare the measured content against the stated percentage to judge conformance.
map.溶质 20 g、溶液 200 g 演练: 20 g of solute in 200 g of solution
map.输入溶质 20 g、溶液 200 g，工具输出质量百分数 10.0%，并提示与体: Enter 20 g of solute and 200 g of solution and the tool gives a mass percentage of 10.0%, noting that switching to a volume percentage needs the density as a bridge.
map.和 mass-fraction 工具重合吗？: Does it overlap with the mass-fraction tool?
map.两者本质同公式；本工具面向「溶质+溶液」直接输入场景，界面更简。: Both use the same formula; this one targets the direct solute plus solution input case with a simpler interface.
map.质量百分数和体积百分数能互换吗？: Can mass and volume percentages be interchanged?
map.需密度桥接，不能直接换；尤其非水体系误差大。: Only through the density as a bridge, not directly; the error is largest for non-aqueous systems.
map.含水量算质量分数吗？: Does water content count towards the mass fraction?
map.算，水作溶剂计入总质量。: Yes, water as the solvent is part of the total mass.
